At One Salon NYC, we provide a variety of cutting services to suit every style and preference, including trims, layers, bobs, and custom cuts tailored to your facial structure and personal style.

We specialize in several coloring techniques: Single Color for a uniform and rich hue, Balayage for a natural, sun-kissed look, Highlights to enhance texture, Double Process for bold transformations, and Platinum for a striking, light blonde. We also offer color Corrections for fixing or changing previously colored hair.

During your first color appointment, you’ll have a consultation with one of our color specialists to discuss your desired outcome and assess your hair’s condition. We may perform a patch test to ensure safety, followed by the color application and proper aftercare instructions.

Our stylists will help you select the best treatment based on your hair’s condition, your daily routine, and your hair goals. Treatments range from moisturizing and repairing to scalp therapies and smoothing treatments.

Hair glossing services revitalize your hair by enhancing the vibrancy of your color, adding shimmering shine, and improving the smoothness and manageability of your hair. It’s perfect for refreshing dull hair and blending natural or colored hair tones.

Yes, we offer high-quality hair extensions in various types, including tape-in, clip-in, and bonded extensions. Our stylists can help you choose the best type based on your lifestyle, hair type, and length goals.
For optimal results, come with clean, dry hair. Avoid using heavy conditioners or oils before your appointment as they can weigh down your hair and affect the styling outcome.

Established in 2022
Welcome to One Salon! Founded by Arsen Kaziyev, known to many as @Dr_Balayage, we're a creative hub born from a decade of expertise in color formulations and hair painting. Arsen, a master stylist, built his reputation and expanded his clientele through a robust following on Instagram, many of whom have become our cherished regulars.

Driven by a passion for delivering exceptional haircuts and colors, Arsen's vision was to create a space where clients feel at home with their hair. This vision came to life with the creation of One Salon, a spacious and welcoming studio. Located in the heart of New York, we take pride in offering top-notch services provided by our team of highly skilled stylists, dedicated to making you look and feel your best.
